title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming Euroleague basketball game between Valencia and FC Bayern Munchen, originally scheduled for Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 2:30 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Valencia win, the market will resolve to "Valencia".
If the FC Bayern Munchen win, the market will resolve to "FC Bayern Munchen".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Saturday, November 14, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
